## ✅ **Current Progress & Key Decisions Made**

- **All roles have completed their pre-deployment tasks**:
  - Backend: Service scaffolded with PII gating and encryption logic.
  - Frontend: Virtualized rendering + debounced polling implemented.
  - DevOps: Staging environment deployed via Terraform/Helm; rollout plan finalized.
  - QA: k6 test suite passed (p(95) = 47ms, error rate = 0.03%, PII masked).
  - Security: Final audit passed — no PII leakage risks.

- **Go/No-Go Decision**: ✅ **GO** — Production deployment approved.

- **Architecture Confirmed**: Unified diagram validated; data flow secure, encrypted, and monitored.

---

## 🔒 **Critical Constraints (Non-Negotiable)**  
> All future actions must comply with **[PERF-SEC-DASH-RT1]**:

| Constraint | Enforcement |
|----------|-------------|
| API latency ≤50ms (95th percentile) under 1500+ users | Monitored in real time |
| PII encrypted at rest/in transit (AES-256 + AWS KMS) | Enforced at source |
| No debug logs in production | Only `WARNING` level allowed |
| PII exposure only when `feature.show_pii = true` | Feature flag + role check required |

> ⚠️ **Violation triggers immediate rollback.**

---

## 📋 **What Remains to Be Done (Next Steps)**

### 🔧 **Turn 6 – Production Deployment & Post-Deploy Validation**

| Task | Owner | Deadline | Success Criteria |
|------|-------|----------|------------------|
| 1. Initiate rolling update to production (Helm + Kubernetes) | DevOps Engineer | T+0 | 10% → 100% rollout over 15 min |
| 2. Monitor real-time metrics: latency, errors, PII masking | DevOps + QA | T+5 to T+20 min | p(95) ≤50ms, error rate <0.1%, no unmasked PII |
| 3. Enable `show_pii=true` via LaunchDarkly | DevOps Engineer | T+18 min | Confirm UI shows decrypted data only for authorized users |
| 4. Verify CloudWatch logs: only `WARNING` level | DevOps Engineer | T+10 min | No `INFO`, `DEBUG`, or `ERROR` logs from app layer |
| 5. Confirm Grafana dashboard reflects live traffic | QA + DevOps | T+15 min | Real-time latency, request rate, cache hit ratio visible |

> 🛑 **If any metric exceeds threshold → Rollback immediately.**

---

> - **Validating all constraints post-deploy**
> - **Initiating rollback if any violation occurs**

> ✅ **Do not proceed without confirming:**
> - All services healthy (K8s readiness probes)
> - PII masking active in real traffic
> - Latency within bounds
